Definition: A bounded, review-only OpenPipeStress capability surface that emits computed values without professional or compliance claims.
Output presented for human review, not as a compliance, approval, certification, sealing, or professional-acceptance result.
An assertion that human review is required and the software makes no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.
A recorded preview-mechanics capability with status implemented, deferred, or requires_private_inputs and a review note.
Paired end-i and end-j local force, moment, or stress recovery results for a pipe segment endpoint.
glTF visual context geometry that is not solver geometry, target-compatibility evidence, or professional validation.
An auditable sidecar mapping canonical stable IDs to glTF export status (emitted, approximated, metadata_only, omitted).
A per-axis record proving coordinate units are preserved while axes are transformed from preview Z-up to glTF Y-up.
A user-supplied set of rule-check criteria and required inputs; not bundled with the public preview.
A rule-check completeness record classifying missing private/protected data and whether it blocks rule check or mechanics solve.
An authored reference binding a rule-check input to a specific solver result row, canonical over the run-panel selector.
A rule-check input source kind referencing a private library record/slot that is never embedded in the rule pack.
The worst-of rule-check run status (e.g. USER_RULE_FAILED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE) lifted to the app envelope.
An SI dual-display unit system with si_canonical calculation basis and entered-units-preserved storage.
An honest diagnostic that a capability (renderer, rule-check backend, library import) requires the Tauri desktop runtime.
A classification of a result row as displacement, reaction, force, moment, stress, ratio, or other.
